step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair, likely serving as an input stage, pre-amplifier, or part of a Current Mode Logic (CML) buffer in the high-speed transceiver.

paper_reference.title: OC-192 Transmitter and Receiver in Standard 0.18-m CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 1mA tail current and 1kOhm load resistors: gm = sqrt(2 * 270uA/V^2 * (5/0.5) * 0.5mA) = 1.64 mS. Gain = gm * R = 1.64 V/V = 4.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain is highly dependent on the chosen load resistors and tail current in the testbench.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the voltage gain drops to 0 dB

paper_reported.value: 10 Gb/s data rate implies >7 GHz bandwidth

sky130_expected.calculation: f_ug = gm / (2 * pi * C_out). With C_out ~ 10fF (parasitics), f_ug = 1.64mS / (2 * pi * 10fF) = 26 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High-speed differential pairs in 130nm can achieve tens of GHz bandwidth with small loads, necessary for 10 Gb/s operation.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single differential pair consumes a very small fraction of the total transceiver chip power.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 1mA tail current fully steered, single-ended swing is 1mA * 1kOhm = 1V. Differential swing is 2V peak-to-peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on input amplitude and tail current steering.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for NMOS differential pair measuring gain, bandwidth, power, and transient swing. Load resistors and a tail current source are added to make the DUT functional.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for NMOS Differential Pair
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmp=5u L_xmp=0.5u
.param W_xmn=5u L_xmn=0.5u

* DUT
XMP VOUTN VINP N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmp} w={W_xmp}
XMN VOUTP VINN N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn} w={W_xmn}

* Biasing and Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 VDD VOUTN 1k
R2 VDD VOUTP 1k
I1 N0 0 1m

* Inputs
VVINP VINP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 0 0)
VVINN VINN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 100MEG 0 0)

* Differential to Single-Ended Converters for Measurement
E_OUT VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUTP VOUTN 1
E_IN VIN_DIFF 0 VINP VINN 1

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1MEG 100G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
meas ac gain_1m find gain_db at=1MEG
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 10p 20n
meas tran vout_diff_max MAX v(VOUT_DIFF)
meas tran vout_diff_min MIN v(VOUT_DIFF)
let swing = vout_diff_max - vout_diff_min
print swing

quit
.endc
